kgs.as_bilingual_pair_policy: Preserve Wolof/French paired statements as one mixed-language candidate when they express the same competency or objective; do not create separate SFIs solely because the same item appears in both languages.
kgs.as_duplicate_review_instructions: Review possible duplicate Senegal Math candidates conservatively. Treat Wolof and French text in the same cell or adjacent paired statements as one bilingual/mixed-language item when they express the same competency or objective. Merge repeated fill-down artifacts that repeat the same competency, palier, objective, or Objectif spécifique in the same domain context. Do not merge items that occur under different paliers, CE levels, activity domains, or week sequence positions unless they are clearly the same source statement repeated for table layout reasons. Do not use table numbers, week labels, palier numbers, or numeric Objectif d'apprentissage values as merge identities because these are local ordering/provenance labels and repeat across tables.

kgs.as_repeated_statement_policy: Merge repeated no-code statements only when the source role, domain/activity area, stage or level, palier context, row/table provenance, and normalized bilingual text match. Keep recurring week-level objectives distinct when they occur under different weeks or paliers. Treat numeric Objectif d'apprentissage values, week numbers, table numbers, CE labels, and palier/jéego numbers as local context/provenance only, not as statement codes or standalone identity keys.
kgs.as_sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract Senegal Math StandardsFrameworkItem candidates from the bilingual Wolof/French curriculum without assuming stable official standard codes. Preserve original Wolof/French source text and language tags. Treat the framework, stage (Tolluwaay 2 / Étape 2 / CE1-CE2), activity domains (Activités numériques, Activités géométriques, Activités de mesure, Résolution de problèmes), CE levels, and paliers/jéego as grouping or sequencing context. In the competency-frame table and competency blocks, extract Compétence de cycle, Compétence de l'étape, and Compétences de base as high-level Standard or Standard Grouping candidates according to context. In planning tables, use Semaine/Palier rows to capture sequence context: extract palier/jéego expectation statements when the row contains the visible palier competency text, and extract weekly activity-cell learning objectives when they are normative learning objectives. Do not extract the labels Semaine 1, Semaine 2, Palier 1, CE1, CE2, Tableau 1, etc. as standalone SFIs or statement_code values. In detailed apprentissages ponctuels tables, treat Objectif spécifique as the main leaf Standard SFI. The Objectif d'apprentissage column in these tables is usually a local numeric ordinal such as 1, 2, or 3; do not extract those numeric values as SFIs, statement_code values, or durable merge keys. Use them only as row-order/provenance context. If an Objectif d'apprentissage cell ever contains a full normative objective instead of a numeric/local label and Objectif spécifique is empty, it may be extracted as the row's leaf Standard. Treat Contenus as descriptor/metadata/guidance attached to the objective, not as a standalone Standard unless explicitly normative. Treat Durée as metadata only. Ignore pure integration/evaluation/checkpoint rows as standards unless they contain a clear learning objective. Always retain provenance, page indices, table local_code, row order, section context, and whether the text came from raw rows, rows_grid, or rows_filldown. Extract Compétence de cycle and Compétence de l'étape when they appear as visible block/paragraph statements under Cadre de compétences / Cëslaayu manoore, not only when they appear in tables. This document has no stable item-level statement codes; do not use table numbers, section numbers, week numbers, CE level labels, palier/jéego numbers, or objective-order numbers as statement_code. Treat them as provenance, hierarchy, or sequencing context only, and set statement_code to null unless a source row contains a true official item code.
kgs.lc_generation_instructions: Create LearningComponents from leaf normative math objectives, especially Objectif spécifique rows. Use the source language text as-is; do not translate for v0. Prefer a 1-to-1 component when the objective is already atomic. Split only when one objective clearly contains multiple distinct mathematical skills. Do not create LearningComponents from Durée, Contenus alone, numeric Objectif d'apprentissage cells, integration/checkpoint labels, or broad domain/palier groupings unless the profile later marks them as LC sources.
